title: The pawn
line: Forward one, two on its first move, and it captures diagonally.

steps.text: A pawn moves one square straight ahead, or two from its starting square. Tap every square the pawn on c2 can reach.
A pawn cannot capture straight ahead, so a piece in front of it stops it. Tap the white pawn that cannot move.
steps.after: The black pawn in front of it blocks it.

steps.text: A pawn captures one square diagonally forward. Capture the pawn on d5.

wrong.e4e5: That moves straight ahead. A pawn captures diagonally.

steps.after: The pawn moved diagonally to capture.

steps.text: Tap every square this pawn can reach.
steps.after: It is blocked straight ahead, but it can capture either knight.

steps.text: A pawn never moves backward. One that reaches the far row becomes another piece, as the lesson on promotion shows.

summary: A pawn moves straight ahead, one square or two from the start, and captures one square diagonally forward.
